assets.name: bivaro-app
assets.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: BIVARO accounting app icon and favicon. Create ONE distinctive premium app emblem: a bold geometric capital B formed by two stacked ledger-book leaves and one rising mint diagonal cut, visually simple and legible at 16 pixels. Front-facing orthographic sculpted enamel, very restrained bevels, broad shapes, precise rounded corners. Deep forest green #063B2D body, luminous mint #79E1AB inlay, tiny ivory edge highlights. Compact square silhouette, fills 84% of square canvas, centered. This is an actual software brand mark, confident and refined, no finance clipart. Genuine transparent alpha around the emblem, no background, no ground shadow, no checkerboard, no wordmark, no extra letters, no watermark. Output only this single isolated icon.
